rationale: The workflow already implements the supported dependency-cache optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE): every job uses actions/setup-go@v4 with cache: true, which caches the Go module download cache keyed on go.mod/go.sum, and the repository provides both go.mod and go.sum as cache inputs. Adding a separate actions/cache step would be redundant. The only other fitting workflow-level pattern, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, requires representative successful-duration history as a precondition, but the repository CI history shows no completed runs (not_a_measured_baseline), so a safe timeout cannot be derived; imposing one on ARM64 jobs—especially lint, which installs Node, Terraform, and golangci-lint—risks failing valid slow runs (contraindication: valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit). Remaining patterns are not applicable: there is no matrix (fail-fast), several are ci_service-scoped or behavior-changing rather than safe workflow edits (cancel-stale, skip-workflow, change-filter), required checks are not verified, and the Bazel/Python/environment-cache patterns do not match this Go repository. Build and test coverage is preserved as-is, and no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment, or new network access is introduced.
